analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($305.25) vs SMA5/20/50($325.17/$324.00/$309.56) — Below SMA50, indicating short-to-mid term trend weakness.
· SMA100/200($288.98/$277.95) Position — Above mid-to-long term trend, maintaining strength.
· 52-week Position (72.5%) — In a declining phase from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (41.3→40.6) — Entering oversold territory, staying neutral.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.8623→-3.1250) — Worsening, signaling bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $303.24) — Approaching lower band, narrowing band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($287.38) — Support based on SMA100.
· Swing Resistance ($317.40) — Resistance based on SMA50, potential trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Failed Higher Low recovery and Lower High formation) — Indicating trend weakening.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.63x) — Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend) — Conditions for observation confirmed.
analysis.patternNote: 볼린저밴드 하단에 근접하며 과매도 구간 진입 조짐을 보이나, MACD 악화와 Higher Low 패턴 실패로 인해 하락 추세가 지속될 가능성이 높다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: Approaching the lower Bollinger Band with signs of entering oversold territory, but the downtrend is likely to continue due to MACD deterioration and a failed Higher Low pattern.
keyPoints: MACD 히스토그램이 음전 후 악화 추세를 지속하며 매도 압력 증가
RSI가 40선 초반에서 반등 동력을 잃고 하락하며 과매도 구간 진입
5일 저가 대비 20일 저가가 하락하며 Higher Low 패턴이 깨져 하락 추세 강화
keyPointsEn: MACD histogram continues to worsen after turning negative, increasing selling pressure.
RSI is losing upward momentum in the low 40s and declining, entering oversold territory.
The 5-day low compared to the 20-day low has fallen, breaking the Higher Low pattern and strengthening the downtrend.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 27.7로 추세가 형성 중이나, -DI가 +DI보다 높아 하락 방향성이 우세하며, 거래량 위축으로 인한 변동성 확대 가능성 존재.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX is forming a trend at 27.7, but -DI is higher than +DI, indicating a dominant downward direction, with potential for increased volatility due to low trading volume.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 금일 RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 조짐을 보였으나, MACD 악화와 가격 패턴 붕괴로 인해 관망세를 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Although the RSI showed signs of entering oversold territory today, the wait-and-see stance is maintained due to MACD deterioration and the breakdown of the price pattern.
